The X.P.C.C. is made up of former soldiers turned economic developers and has a notorious international reputation for its coercive tactics. (The X.P.C.C. did not respond to a request for comment.) 在中国生产这类鱼的人员还面临着额外风险。中国政府试图利用养鱼业连同棉花种植和番茄种植等其他产业同化在新疆占人口多数的非汉族少数民族——这一努力还涉及强迫绝育、打压宗教活动及母语。这种同化主要由与军队有松散联系的企业实体新疆生产建设兵团监督执行。该兵团由退伍军人转隶的经济开发者组成，并因强制手段在国际上声名狼藉。（兵团未回应置评请求。） PLATES 餐桌 By the time farmed seafood reaches your plate, it bears no trace of the harms to people and the environment that were required to produce it. 等到端上你的餐桌时，养殖海鲜已不带任何生产过程中对人类和环境造成的伤害痕迹。 More than 80 percent of the seafood eaten in the United States comes from overseas. 美国食用的海鲜中有80%以上来自海外。 Since 2022, the country has been the world’s largest importer of seafood, bringing in enormous quantities of shrimp, salmon, tilapia and catfish. 自2022年起，美国已成为全球最大的海鲜进口国，引进了大量的虾、三文鱼、罗非鱼和鲶鱼。 Only a tiny fraction is inspected on its way into the country. 只有极少部分海鲜在入境时接受了检查。 The United States imports so much seafood in large part because American aquaculture is subject to significant oversight and regulation to protect health, safety and the environment. Federal and state rules dictate where fish farms can be built and the allowable levels of water quality, waste discharge, genetic modification and antibiotic use. These operations end up paying more than their counterparts abroad for higher-quality water treatment systems and testing equipment. Across commonly farmed seafood varieties, including salmon, shrimp and tilapia, domestic brands consistently command a steep price premium over foreign ones — in some cases double the cost. 美国大量进口海鲜，很大程度上是因为美国的水产养殖业受制于为保护健康、安全和环境而设立的严格监管。联邦和各州的规定对养鱼场选址及水质、废水排放、基因改造和允许使用抗生素的标准都有严格限制。这些企业最终需比其海外同行支付更多费用来配置高标准的水处理系统和检测设备。在包括三文鱼、虾和罗非鱼等常见养殖海鲜品种中，国产品牌的价格始终大幅高于外国品牌——某些情况下甚至达到后者的两倍。 In recent decades, often in response to public pressure, the American government has started to crack down on illegally or unfairly produced foreign goods, such as diamonds, garments and coffee. But there has been little outcry to date about seafood imports or the government’s performance in policing their origins and quality. 近几十年来，为回应公众压力，美国政府已开始严厉打击非法或不公平手段生产的外国商品，如钻石、服装和咖啡。但迄今为止，对于海鲜进口或政府在核查其来源和质量方面的作为，外界却鲜有强烈抗议。 As of now, farmed fish produced using fishmeal is everywhere, sold in big grocery stores like Walmart and Kroger and served in cafeterias — even on Capitol Hill. If in the past year or so you sat down at any of the handful of cafeterias frequented by members of Congress, their staffs, and visitors in town for a tour, there’s a decent chance you dined on farmed seafood produced using fishmeal. Some of it could even have originated in Xinjiang, despite the fact that, in 2021, Congress banned entry of any goods produced “wholly or in part” in the region, on the presumption that such products involve state-imposed forced labor. (The U.S. government has formally characterized China’s actions in Xinjiang as a form of genocide.) 如今，用鱼粉饲养的养殖鱼随处可见，它们在沃尔玛和克罗格等大型超市有售，并供应于各地的食堂——甚至包括国会山。如果你在过去一年里曾在国会议员、其工作人员及来此参观的游客经常光顾的那几家自助餐厅中就餐，那你很有可能吃过使用鱼粉生产的养殖海鲜。其中有些甚至可能产自新疆，尽管国会曾在2021年以涉嫌国家强制劳动为由，禁止全部或部分在该地区生产的任何商品入境。（美国政府已正式将中国在新疆的行动定性为一种种族灭绝形式。） But American authorities inspect only a minuscule fraction of the seafood that is imported by China to the United States. Just this summer, after the Outlaw Ocean Project testified before Congress about the illegal flow of seafood from Xinjiang into the United States, the federal government added another Chinese exporter of farmed seafood to its list of banned companies: Xinjiang Tianyun Organic Agriculture. 但美国当局仅抽查了中国进口至美国的极小部分海鲜。就在今年夏天，“非法海洋”项目(Outlaw Ocean)向国会提供关于来自新疆的海鲜非法流入美国的证词后，联邦政府将另一家中国养殖海鲜出口商列入禁令名单：新疆天蕴有机农业有限公司。 Producing about 40 percent of China’s farmed salmon, Tianyun ships its fish through a major Chinese processor, Dalian Rich, which has supplied the American seafood brand Aqua Star, whose products are sold by Walmart and other major outlets, like the food distribution giant Sysco. Food from Sysco goes to nearly every corner of the American marketplace — more than 400,000 businesses in the last six weeks alone — as well as public school cafeterias, federal prisons, military bases and the dining halls on Capitol Hill. 天蕴生产了中国约40%的养殖三文鱼，其鱼类产品通过中国一家主要加工商大连瑞驰运输，而大连瑞驰又为美国海鲜品牌Aqua Star供货。Aqua Star的产品由沃尔玛及食品分销巨头西斯科(Sysco)等大型销售网络进行销售。仅在过去六周内，西斯科的食品就送达了美国市场的几乎每个角落——超过40万家企业——以及公立学校食堂、联邦监狱、军事基地和国会山的餐厅。 (Xinjiang Tianyun Organic Agriculture said that it strictly complies with China’s laws on labor and contracts, and that it “has never been involved in, nor will it ever participate in, any form of forced labor.” A Sysco spokeswoman said the company takes seriously its obligation and commitment to uphold all international and local laws that protect labor, human and child labor rights, as well as the environment. Dalian Rich and Aqua Star did not respond to requests for comment. Walmart confirmed that it sources seafood from Aqua Star.) （新疆天蕴有机农业有限公司 表示其严格遵守 中国关于劳动与合同的法律，并声明“从未参与也永远不会参与任何形式的强迫劳动”。西斯科发言人表示， 公司认真履行 其维护所有保护劳工、人权和童工权利及环境的国际及地方法律的义务和承诺。大连瑞驰和Aqua Star未回应置评请求。沃尔玛确认其从Aqua Star采购海鲜。） Sysco says on its website that its “reputation is built upon the highest ethical standards of business conduct and fair dealing.” But our investigation found that fishing ships that supply Copeinca, the company whose workers died by toxic fume inhalation and that produces fishmeal for shrimp sold by Sysco, were tied to at least 30 fishing violations or other concerns, including fishing in marine protected areas, exceeding catch limits, and operating without a valid permit. (Copeinca said that it had “all valid permits required under Peruvian fisheries regulations,” and that there were no “final sanctions” on some of these matters because the company was disputing or appealing them.) 西斯科在其官网上标榜其“声誉建立在最高道德标准的商业行为与公平交易之上”。但我们的调查发现，那些为Copeinca供货的捕鱼船，涉及在海洋保护区内捕鱼、超出捕捞限额以及无证作业等至少30项违规行为或问题。值得注意的是，曾有工人死于吸入有毒烟雾的Copeinca还生产用于养殖西斯科所售虾类的鱼粉。（Copeinca表示，公司拥有“秘鲁渔业法规要求的所有有效许可”，并且上述部分问题并未受到“最终制裁”，因为公司正在就这些问题提出异议或上诉。） The gap between marketing rhetoric and supply-chain realities is common across the industry. Since 2019, at least nine lawsuits alleging false advertising have been brought against seafood companies in the United States. The companies paid more than $2 million in settlement fees to resolve the cases. Dana Cleaveley, a research consultant formerly with SeaChoice, a Canadian sustainable-seafood group, says that as the public exerts more pressure on the seafood industry to better police supply chains, “investors will begin to see material, not just reputational, risk, and companies will have to adjust.” 营销说辞与供应链现实脱节的现象在整个行业十分普遍。自2019年以来，美国已针对海鲜公司发起了至少九起涉嫌虚假宣传的诉讼。这些公司支付了逾200万美元的和解金以了结案件。加拿大可持续海鲜组织海洋选择组织(SeaChoice)前研究顾问达娜·克利夫利表示，随着公众对海鲜行业施加更大压力以要求其更好地监管供应链，“投资者将开始看到实质性的风险，而不仅仅是声誉风险，各大公司将不得不做出调整。” The popularity of farmed seafood, in the United States and elsewhere, is only going to grow. The United Nations predicts that almost two-thirds of seafood eaten worldwide will come from aquaculture by 2035. Most of that production is likely to rely on fishmeal. 无论在美国还是其他国家，养殖海鲜的受欢迎程度势必会继续攀升。联合国 预测 指出，到2035年，全球消费的海鲜中近三分之二将来自水产养殖。而绝大部分产量很可能依然依赖于鱼粉。 One way the industry could adjust would be to farm more seafood that does not need to be fed other fish. Bivalves like mussels, oysters, clams and scallops grow by filtering food from the water, so they don’t require manufactured feed. And where that feed is still needed, it could be made through the more efficient processing of leftovers — wasting less of the fish caught in the wild — and alternative ingredients such as algae, insects and microbial proteins. 该行业可以通过培育更多无需投喂其他鱼类的海鲜来进行调整。贻贝、牡蛎、蛤蜊和扇贝等双壳类动物靠过滤水中的食物生长，因此无需人工饲料。在仍需饲料的地方，可以通过更高效地处理厨余垃圾——从而减少浪费野生捕捞的鱼类——并利用藻类、昆虫和微生物蛋白等替代原料进行生产。 Otherwise, the once-glowing promise of fish farming — grow more fish, catch fewer fish — is likely to remain broken. 否则，水产养殖业曾光芒万丈的承诺——养更多的鱼，捕更少的鱼——很可能会继续成为泡影。 Ian Urbina曾任《纽约时报》调查记者，是《纽约时报》的调查记者，他目前运营着“非法海洋”项目，这是一个位于华盛顿特区的非营利新闻机构，致力于报道人权、环境和劳工问题。这篇报道是非法海洋项目 国际记者团队 开展的一项大型调查的一部分。 信息图表制作：Laura Edelbacher 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 人工智能推波助澜，网络攻击席卷日本
description: TIFFANY MAY, KIUKO NOTOYA2026年10月14日日本遭遇了一波网络攻击，企业和政府均受影响。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times A wave of cyberattacks has wreaked havoc in Japan over the past few weeks, leaving virtually no industry untouched and the government searching for answers about how to bolster its defenses. 过去几周，一波网络攻击席卷日本，造成严重混乱，几乎没有哪个行业能够幸免。日本政府正在设法寻找加强网络防御的对策。 The hackers have tampered with servers, taken local government websites offline and gained access to large tranches of consumer data. Masaaki Taira, Japan’s former digital minister who leads a cybersecurity committee within the ruling Liberal Democratic Party, declared on Friday that Japan was in “a state of emergency in cyberspace.” 黑客篡改服务器、使地方政府网站陷入瘫痪，并获取了大量消费者数据。日本前数字大臣、执政党自民党网络安全委员会负责人平将明周五宣称，日本处于“网络空间紧急状态”。 Experts said that the attackers were most likely motivated by money. After paralyzing operations, they could attempt to extort local governments and companies into paying large ransoms, or sell the stolen information. 专家表示，攻击者最有可能是出于经济利益的驱动。他们在瘫痪相关机构的运营后，可能试图勒索地方政府和企业索取巨额赎金，或出售窃取的信息。 “Their actions may result in the suspension or degradation of systems and services that are important to society,” said Katsunari Yoshioka, a professor at Yokohama National University and an expert in systems security. 横滨国立大学教授、系统安全专家吉冈克成表示：“他们的行为可能导致对社会至关重要的系统和服务中断或性能下降。” A study by TrendAI, a cybersecurity software company, found 600 cyberattacks were reported in Japan in the first nine months of 2026, more than the total number in 2025. 网络安全软件公司TrendAI的一项研究发现，2026年前九个月，日本报告了600起网络攻击，超过2025年全年总数。 In the past two weeks, a public university had to cancel classes for a week after its servers were attacked. A car-sharing service said that more than one million personal documents had been leaked, including headshots on driver’s licenses and home addresses. A ransomware attack on a cloud service operator owned by SoftBank affected almost 500 companies and local governments, including a rail operator and a police headquarters. 过去两周内，一所公立大学的服务器遭到攻击后不得不停课一周；一家汽车共享服务公司表示，超过100万份包含个人信息的文件遭到泄露，其中包括驾照上的大头照和家庭住址；软银旗下的一家云服务运营商遭到勒索软件攻击，波及近500家企业和地方政府，其中包括一家铁路运营商和一个警察总部。 Ransomware attacks have caused major problems in recent years well before A.I., but experts said artificial intelligence may have made these attacks easier. 早在人工智能出现之前，勒索软件攻击就已在近年造成严重问题，但专家表示，人工智能可能让发动这些攻击变得更加容易。 Toshiharu Furukawa, Japan’s minister of digital transformation, said at a news conference on Friday in Tokyo that the cyberattacks were reaching “across all sectors.” 日本数字转型大臣古川俊治周五在东京的新闻发布会上说，网络攻击正波及“所有行业”。 上个月，日本数字转型大臣古川俊治在东京出席活动。 Why Japan? 为什么是日本？ As the world’s fourth-largest economy that produces many of the world’s robots, cars and electronics, Japan has long been an attractive target for hackers. Even though it was an early adopter of technology, its cybersecurity infrastructure is underdeveloped, according to experts. 日本是世界第四大经济体，也是全球许多机器人、汽车和电子产品的生产国，长期以来它一直是黑客眼中的理想攻击目标。专家指出，尽管日本很早就开始采用新技术，但其网络安全基础设施仍然不够完善。 A Microsoft report found that, in 2026, Japan was second only to Taiwan as the most frequently affected by cyberthreats in Asia. The International Institute for Strategic Studies, a London think tank, placed Japan in the lowest of three tiers ranking countries on their cyber capabilities in a 2021 assessment. The report noted that Japan’s military had avoided offensive cybersecurity strategies in the past, in part because of the pacifist constitution the country enacted after World War II. 微软的一份报告发现，2026年，日本是亚洲遭受网络威胁最频繁的地区之一，仅次于台湾。伦敦智库国际战略研究所2021年对各国网络能力进行评估时，将日本列入三个等级中的最低一级。报告指出，日本军方过去一直避免采取进攻性的网络安全战略，部分原因是日本在第二次世界大战后制定的和平宪法。 Artificial intelligence has also turbocharged the work of hackers, experts say. Automated systems can now scan websites for vulnerabilities around the world and around the clock. 专家表示，人工智能还大大提高了黑客的攻击效率。自动化系统现在可以全天候扫描全球网站，寻找安全漏洞。 Takahiro Anno, a technologist and founder of a political party focused on A.I., said while the Japanese language had once hindered international hackers, A.I.-generated translations have made phishing campaigns more persuasive. 技术专家、一个以人工智能为重点的政党的创始人安野贵博表示，过去日语曾是国际黑客发动攻击的一道障碍，但人工智能生成的翻译让网络钓鱼攻击更具迷惑性。 “Until recently — specifically up to about five years ago — Japan seemed relatively insulated from ransomware attacks and similar threats” he said in an interview. “It is very clear in emails or on phone calls when someone cannot speak Japanese fluently, so phishing campaigns were not that successful.” “直到最近——具体说大约五年前——日本似乎相对不受勒索软件攻击和类似威胁影响，”他在采访中说。“如果一个人日语说得不流利，无论是在电子邮件还是电话中，都很容易被察觉，因此网络钓鱼攻击的成功率并不高。” Ko Fujii, a technology expert and the founder of Makaira, a public affairs agency, said the recent wave of cyberattacks was unlikely to be part of a coordinated, state-sponsored geopolitical attack, according to his agency’s preliminary analysis. 公共事务咨询公司Makaira创始人、技术专家藤井宏一郎说，根据该机构初步分析，最近这波网络攻击不太可能是一次由国家支持、经过协调的地缘政治攻击行动。 “Japan suffered a high volume of breaches simply because its unpatched infrastructure yielded the highest return on investment” for hackers, he said. 他说：“日本之所以遭遇大量网络入侵，纯粹是因为其基础设施中的漏洞没有得到修补，让黑客能够获得最高的投入回报。” It is unclear what threats the hackers had made, and how the companies have responded to any demands. The Japanese police said last week that the Russian ransomware group Qilin had been responsible for attacks on 53 Japanese companies over the past year and that a suspect had been extradited to Germany. It is unclear if Qilin was responsible for some of the recent cyber attacks. 目前尚不清楚黑客提出了哪些威胁，以及遭到攻击的企业如何回应他们的要求。日本警方上周表示，俄罗斯勒索软件组织“麒麟”在过去一年中对53家日本企业发动了攻击，一名嫌疑人已被引渡至德国。目前尚不清楚“麒麟”是否参与了最近的部分网络攻击。 How is the government responding? 政府如何应对？ The government has issued alerts with updated guidelines on handling personnel information, Mr. Furukawa said, including removing personal data that is no longer needed and requiring two-factor authentication. 古川表示，政府已发布警报，并更新了处理人事信息的指南，包括删除不再需要的个人数据，并要求双重认证。 The government was still investigating the causes of the attacks, including whether A.I. was used. “Progress in clarifying the details of these incidents has been slow,” he said. 政府仍在调查攻击原因，包括是否使用了人工智能。“查明这些事件细节的进展缓慢，”他说。 A new cyberdefense law took effect earlier in October that allows the national police and Japan’s military to monitor and even disable foreign servers and infrastructure to protect national security interests. The law also makes it mandatory for companies to report breaches. 一项新的网络防御法规于10月初生效，它允许日本警察和军方监控甚至禁用境外服务器和相关基础设施，以维护国家安全利益。该法律还强制企业必须报告网络安全遭入侵事件。 Professor Yoshioka, the systems security specialist, who advised the government as it developed the new law, called for international collaboration, as the infrastructure behind the attacks was unlikely to be confined to Japan. 系统安全专家吉冈教授曾在新法制定过程中为政府提供建议。他呼吁开展国际合作，因为攻击背后的基础设施不太可能仅限于日本境内。 Hans van der Heijden, a Melbourne-based digital forensics specialist at the global risks consultancy firm Control Risks, said that while Japan has made significant strides in its cybersecurity infrastructure, the process will take time and investment. 全球风险咨询公司Control Risks驻墨尔本数字取证专家汉斯·范德海登说，虽然日本在网络安全基础设施方面取得了显著进展，但这一过程需要时间和投资。 “Some organizations continue to face challenges in patching vulnerabilities, replacing outdated technology, and implementing modern security controls,” Mr. van der Heijden wrote in an email. 范德海登在一封电子邮件中写道：“一些机构在修补安全漏洞、更换过时技术以及实施现代化安全控制措施方面，仍然面临挑战。” In the meantime, the cyberthreats will continue, he said. 他说，与此同时，网络安全威胁仍将持续存在。 赫海威(Javier C. Hernández)自东京对本文有报道贡献。 Tiffany May是时报驻香港记者，报道香港和更广泛地区的政治、商业和文化议题。 Kiuko Notoya是一名常驻东京的记者/研究员，报道日本新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: TIFFANY MAY, KIUKO NOTOYA 2026年10月14日 日本遭遇了一波网络攻击，企业和政府均受影响。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times A wave of cyberattacks has wreaked havoc in Japan over the past few weeks, leaving virtually no industry untouched and the government searching for answers about how to bolster its defenses. 过去几周，一波网络攻击席卷日本，造成严重混乱，几乎没有哪个行业能够幸免。日本政府正在设法寻找加强网络防御的对策。 The hackers have tampered with servers, taken local government websites offline and gained access to large tranches of consumer data. Masaaki Taira, Japan’s former digital minister who leads a cybersecurity committee within the ruling Liberal Democratic Party, declared on Friday that Japan was in “a state of emergency in cyberspace.” 黑客篡改服务器、使地方政府网站陷入瘫痪，并获取了大量消费者数据。日本前数字大臣、执政党自民党网络安全委员会负责人平将明周五宣称，日本处于“网络空间紧急状态”。 Experts said that the attackers were most likely motivated by money. After paralyzing operations, they could attempt to extort local governments and companies into paying large ransoms, or sell the stolen information. 专家表示，攻击者最有可能是出于经济利益的驱动。他们在瘫痪相关机构的运营后，可能试图勒索地方政府和企业索取巨额赎金，或出售窃取的信息。 “Their actions may result in the suspension or degradation of systems and services that are important to society,” said Katsunari Yoshioka, a professor at Yokohama National University and an expert in systems security. 横滨国立大学教授、系统安全专家吉冈克成表示：“他们的行为可能导致对社会至关重要的系统和服务中断或性能下降。” A study by TrendAI, a cybersecurity software company, found 600 cyberattacks were reported in Japan in the first nine months of 2026, more than the total number in 2025. 网络安全软件公司TrendAI的一项研究发现，2026年前九个月，日本报告了600起网络攻击，超过2025年全年总数。 In the past two weeks, a public university had to cancel classes for a week after its servers were attacked. A car-sharing service said that more than one million personal documents had been leaked, including headshots on driver’s licenses and home addresses. A ransomware attack on a cloud service operator owned by SoftBank affected almost 500 companies and local governments, including a rail operator and a police headquarters. 过去两周内，一所公立大学的服务器遭到攻击后不得不停课一周；一家汽车共享服务公司表示，超过100万份包含个人信息的文件遭到泄露，其中包括驾照上的大头照和家庭住址；软银旗下的一家云服务运营商遭到勒索软件攻击，波及近500家企业和地方政府，其中包括一家铁路运营商和一个警察总部。 Ransomware attacks have caused major problems in recent years well before A.I., but experts said artificial intelligence may have made these attacks easier. 早在人工智能出现之前， 勒索软件攻击 就已在近年造成严重问题，但专家表示，人工智能可能让发动这些攻击变得更加容易。 Toshiharu Furukawa , Japan’s minister of digital transformation, said at a news conference on Friday in Tokyo that the cyberattacks were reaching “across all sectors.” 日本数字转型大臣 古川俊治 周五在东京的新闻发布会上说，网络攻击正波及“所有行业”。 上个月，日本数字转型大臣古川俊治在东京出席活动。 Why Japan? 为什么是日本？ As the world’s fourth-largest economy that produces many of the world’s robots, cars and electronics, Japan has long been an attractive target for hackers. Even though it was an early adopter of technology, its cybersecurity infrastructure is underdeveloped, according to experts. 日本是世界第四大经济体，也是全球许多机器人、汽车和电子产品的生产国，长期以来它一直是黑客眼中的理想攻击目标。专家指出，尽管日本很早就开始采用新技术，但其网络安全基础设施仍然不够完善。 A Microsoft report found that, in 2026, Japan was second only to Taiwan as the most frequently affected by cyberthreats in Asia. The International Institute for Strategic Studies, a London think tank, placed Japan in the lowest of three tiers ranking countries on their cyber capabilities in a 2021 assessment . The report noted that Japan’s military had avoided offensive cybersecurity strategies in the past, in part because of the pacifist constitution the country enacted after World War II. 微软的一份报告 发现，2026年，日本是亚洲遭受网络威胁最频繁的地区之一，仅次于台湾。伦敦智库国际战略研究所2021年对各国网络能力进行 评估 时，将日本列入三个等级中的最低一级。报告指出，日本军方过去一直避免采取进攻性的网络安全战略，部分原因是日本在第二次世界大战后制定的和平宪法。 Artificial intelligence has also turbocharged the work of hackers, experts say. Automated systems can now scan websites for vulnerabilities around the world and around the clock. 专家表示，人工智能还大大提高了黑客的攻击效率。自动化系统现在可以全天候扫描全球网站，寻找安全漏洞。 Takahiro Anno, a technologist and founder of a political party focused on A.I ., said while the Japanese language had once hindered international hackers, A.I.-generated translations have made phishing campaigns more persuasive. 技术专家、 一个以人工智能为重点的政党 的创始人安野贵博表示，过去日语曾是国际黑客发动攻击的一道障碍，但人工智能生成的翻译让网络钓鱼攻击更具迷惑性。 “Until recently — specifically up to about five years ago — Japan seemed relatively insulated from ransomware attacks and similar threats” he said in an interview. “It is very clear in emails or on phone calls when someone cannot speak Japanese fluently, so phishing campaigns were not that successful.” “直到最近——具体说大约五年前——日本似乎相对不受勒索软件攻击和类似威胁影响，”他在采访中说。“如果一个人日语说得不流利，无论是在电子邮件还是电话中，都很容易被察觉，因此网络钓鱼攻击的成功率并不高。” Ko Fujii, a technology expert and the founder of Makaira, a public affairs agency, said the recent wave of cyberattacks was unlikely to be part of a coordinated, state-sponsored geopolitical attack, according to his agency’s preliminary analysis. 公共事务咨询公司Makaira创始人、技术专家藤井宏一郎说，根据该机构初步分析，最近这波网络攻击不太可能是一次由国家支持、经过协调的地缘政治攻击行动。 “Japan suffered a high volume of breaches simply because its unpatched infrastructure yielded the highest return on investment” for hackers, he said. 他说：“日本之所以遭遇大量网络入侵，纯粹是因为其基础设施中的漏洞没有得到修补，让黑客能够获得最高的投入回报。” It is unclear what threats the hackers had made, and how the companies have responded to any demands. The Japanese police said last week that the Russian ransomware group Qilin had been responsible for attacks on 53 Japanese companies over the past year and that a suspect had been extradited to Germany. It is unclear if Qilin was responsible for some of the recent cyber attacks. 目前尚不清楚黑客提出了哪些威胁，以及遭到攻击的企业如何回应他们的要求。日本警方上周表示，俄罗斯勒索软件组织“麒麟”在过去一年中对53家日本企业发动了攻击，一名嫌疑人已被引渡至德国。目前尚不清楚“麒麟”是否参与了最近的部分网络攻击。 How is the government responding? 政府如何应对？ The government has issued alerts with updated guidelines on handling personnel information, Mr. Furukawa said, including removing personal data that is no longer needed and requiring two-factor authentication. 古川表示，政府已发布警报，并更新了处理人事信息的指南，包括删除不再需要的个人数据，并要求双重认证。 The government was still investigating the causes of the attacks, including whether A.I. was used. “Progress in clarifying the details of these incidents has been slow,” he said. 政府仍在调查攻击原因，包括是否使用了人工智能。“查明这些事件细节的进展缓慢，”他说。 A new cyberdefense law took effect earlier in October that allows the national police and Japan’s military to monitor and even disable foreign servers and infrastructure to protect national security interests. The law also makes it mandatory for companies to report breaches. 一项新的网络防御法规于10月初生效，它允许日本警察和军方监控甚至禁用境外服务器和相关基础设施，以维护国家安全利益。该法律还强制企业必须报告网络安全遭入侵事件。 Professor Yoshioka, the systems security specialist, who advised the government as it developed the new law, called for international collaboration, as the infrastructure behind the attacks was unlikely to be confined to Japan. 系统安全专家吉冈教授曾在新法制定过程中为政府提供建议。他呼吁开展国际合作，因为攻击背后的基础设施不太可能仅限于日本境内。 Hans van der Heijden, a Melbourne-based digital forensics specialist at the global risks consultancy firm Control Risks, said that while Japan has made significant strides in its cybersecurity infrastructure, the process will take time and investment. 全球风险咨询公司Control Risks驻墨尔本数字取证专家汉斯·范德海登说，虽然日本在网络安全基础设施方面取得了显著进展，但这一过程需要时间和投资。 “Some organizations continue to face challenges in patching vulnerabilities, replacing outdated technology, and implementing modern security controls,” Mr. van der Heijden wrote in an email. 范德海登在一封电子邮件中写道：“一些机构在修补安全漏洞、更换过时技术以及实施现代化安全控制措施方面，仍然面临挑战。” In the meantime, the cyberthreats will continue, he said. 他说，与此同时，网络安全威胁仍将持续存在。 赫海威(Javier C. Hernández)自东京对本文有报道贡献。 Tiffany May 是时报驻香港记者，报道香港和更广泛地区的政治、商业和文化议题。 Kiuko Notoya 是一名常驻东京的记者/研究员，报道日本新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: FBI捣毁涉朝鲜IT诈骗网络：盗用身份获取美国工作岗位
description: DUSTIN VOLZ2026年10月14日美国官员称，近年来，朝鲜通过远程IT工作者项目规避了国际制裁，赚取了数十亿美元的现金。 Anthony Wallace/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images The F.B.I. last month disrupted a widespread network of American facilitators accused of aiding the North Korean government in securing remote information technology jobs that helped fund the reclusive country’s nuclear and ballistic weapons programs, U.S. officials said Tuesday. 美国官员周二表示，联邦调查局上个月捣毁了一个由美国人组成的广泛网络，这些人被指控帮助朝鲜政府获取远程信息技术工作岗位，从而为这个与世隔绝的国家的核武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。 The operation included the dismantling of more than 40 so-called laptop farms across Texas and the seizure of nearly 200 computer devices, the officials said, marking one of the largest efforts to date by U.S. authorities to block a key revenue stream that has helped North Korea evade harsh international sanctions and generate billions in cash in recent years. 官员们表示，此次行动包括在得克萨斯州各地捣毁了40多个所谓“笔记本电脑农场”，并查获近200台计算机设备。这是美国当局迄今为止为阻断这一关键收入来源所采取的最大规模行动之一。近年来，这一收入来源帮助朝鲜规避了严厉的国际制裁，并创造了数十亿美元的现金。 The Justice Department separately unsealed indictments in Ohio on Tuesday against two U.S. nationals and 10 China-based North Koreans accused of committing identity theft to earn paychecks from unwitting American companies that hired them. Prosecutors said that scheme bilked 70 companies out of more than $3 million and ran from 2019 to 2025. The identities of two additional defendants remained under seal. 另外，美国司法部周二在俄亥俄州解封了针对两名美国公民和10名驻华朝鲜人的起诉书，指控他们通过盗用身份信息，从不知情的美国雇主处骗取薪资。检察官表示，该计划从2019年持续到2025年，骗取了70家公司超过300万美元。另外两名被告的身份仍处于保密状态。 The moves were the latest by the United States in an intensifying campaign to try to cut off a stealthy and evolving digital threat from North Korea whose scale is not entirely clear but likely vast. U.S. intelligence officials in both the Biden and second Trump administrations have said the I.T. worker scams are a primary method of funding Pyongyang’s weapons program, alongside thefts of cryptocurrency. 这些举措是美国在不断升级的行动中采取的最新手段，旨在试图切断来自朝鲜的隐秘且不断演变的数字威胁，这种威胁的规模尚不完全清楚，但可能非常庞大。拜登政府和第二届特朗普政府的美国情报官员都曾表示，IT人员诈骗与窃取加密货币一样，是为平壤武器项目提供资金的主要方式。 North Korea is deploying “thousands of state-controlled I.T. workers to infiltrate companies in the United States and allied countries,” Brett Leatherman, the head of the F.B.I.’s cyber division, said in an interview. “Every one of these jobs is funding a stream for a nuclear and ballistic missiles program obtained with the stolen identity of an American and the trust of an American employer.” “朝鲜正在部署数以千计受国家控制的IT人员，渗透美国及其盟国的企业，”联邦调查局网络部门负责人布雷特·莱瑟曼在接受采访时表示。“他们利用窃取的美国人身份和美国雇主的信任获得了这些工作，而每一份这样的工作都在为核武器和弹道导弹项目提供资金来源。” The bureau worked closely with the U.S.-based cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike to identify and disrupt the network, Mr. Leatherman said. He added that the coordinated actions were an early example of the F.B.I.’s new cyber strategy, which was unveiled last month and promised closer collaboration with the private sector to target hackers in ways that impede or thwart malicious activity. The strategy is part of a broader effort across the Trump administration to work more closely with American companies to strike hackers with cyberattacks, a pivot cautiously welcomed by some security experts. 莱瑟曼说，联邦调查局与总部位于美国的网络安全公司CrowdStrike密切合作，查明并捣毁了这个网络。他还说，这些协调行动是联邦调查局新网络战略的早期范例，该战略于上个月公布，承诺与私营部门加强合作，以阻碍或挫败恶意活动的方式打击黑客。该战略是特朗普政府更广泛举措的一部分，旨在与美国企业更紧密地合作，通过网络攻击打击黑客，一些安全专家对此转变表示谨慎欢迎。 U.S. officials and cybersecurity analysts have said the North Korean I.T. worker scheme is among the most serious ongoing digital threats facing businesses today, and that it remains underappreciated as a risk. Adam Meyers, who oversees counteradversary operations at CrowdStrike, said the North Korean schemes to get hired for jobs have been “increasing both in prevalence and complexity.” 美国官员和网络安全分析师表示，朝鲜IT人员骗局是当今企业面临的最严重的持续性数字威胁之一，但其风险仍被低估。负责CrowdStrike反制对手行动的亚当·迈耶斯表示，朝鲜获取雇佣的骗局“在普遍性和复杂性方面都在不断增加”。 It is difficult to know how widespread laptop farms are in the United States, Mr. Meyers said, but noted that CrowdStrike identified an average of two new cases per day throughout the month of September — which is likely only the tip of the iceberg. 迈耶斯说，目前尚难以确定笔记本电脑农场在美国的普及程度，但他指出，CrowdStrike在整个9月份平均每天发现两起新案例——而这可能只是冰山一角。 For more than two years, U.S. intelligence officials and cybersecurity researchers have warned that North Korea has been using stolen American identities — often acquired from compromised private information, like Social Security numbers, on the dark web — and artificial intelligence tools to get hired for remote information technology jobs at companies across the United States, Europe and elsewhere. Experts have said companies ranging from small start-ups to Fortune 500 firms have been victimized. 两年多来，美国情报官员和网络安全研究人员一直警告称，朝鲜一直在利用窃取的美国人身份——通常是从暗网上泄露的隐私信息中获取（如社会安全号码）——以及人工智能工具，在美国、欧洲及其他地方的公司获得远程信息技术工作。专家表示，从小微初创企业到财富500强公司，各类企业都已成为受害者。 A crucial aspect of the fraud campaign is support from people in the United States who are recruited by North Korea to help bypass corporate security measures that detect fraudulent hires, according to investigators. Facilitators help enable the fraud by receiving and setting up work laptops at addresses that appear like legitimate residences to corporate human-resources teams. North Korean operators then use software to remotely tunnel into those laptops and work on them, posing as Americans to the companies that hired them. 调查人员表示，这场欺诈活动的一个关键环节是来自美国境内人员的协助，他们被朝鲜招募，帮助绕过企业用于检测欺诈性雇佣的安全措施。协助者通过在看似合法住所的地址接收并设置工作笔记本电脑，从而为欺诈行为提供便利，使企业人力资源团队误以为这些地址是合法住所。然后，朝鲜操作员使用软件远程登录这些笔记本电脑并在其上工作，向雇佣他们的公司冒充美国人。 The appeal for facilitators is simple: jobs that look like easy cash and, at least at first, might not require much of them. “They get kind of hooked on it initially, and then more gets asked of them, and they’re kind of in too deep at that point,” Mr. Meyers said. 对协助者来说，诱惑很简单：这些工作看似能轻松赚钱，而且至少在最初可能不需要他们做太多事情。“他们一开始有点上瘾，然后被要求做得更多，到那个时候，他们就已经陷得太深了，”迈耶斯说。 Mr. Leatherman said that the Texas sweep did not include any arrests of facilitators, but that authorities warned them they could face criminal penalties should they continue to assist with remote fraud. The decision stemmed in part from a desire to move quickly to upend the network rather than wait for prosecutors to file charges, he said. 莱瑟曼说，得克萨斯州的扫荡行动中并没有逮捕任何协助者，但当局警告他们，如果继续协助远程欺诈，可能会面临刑事处罚。他说，这一决定部分源于希望迅速采取行动瓦解该网络，而不是等待检察官提起指控。 Mr. Leatherman said the laptop farms often operate like a “mini data center” for the North Koreans, where one facilitator hosts dozens or even hundreds of laptops used to fill scores of jobs. A woman in Arizona sentenced last year to more than eight years in prison was accused of hosting dozens of laptops at her home to help North Koreans connect to more than 300 U.S. companies. 莱瑟曼表示，这些笔记本电脑农场的运作模式往往就像一个朝鲜人的“迷你数据中心”， 一名协助者会托管数十台甚至数百台笔记本电脑，用于处理大量工作任务。去年一名女子在亚利桑那州被判处八年多监禁，她被控在其家中托管数十台笔记本电脑，帮助朝鲜人连接到300多家美国公司。 The tactics of North Korea’s I.T. worker army have steadily evolved to evade detection. That includes increased reliance on artificial intelligence to create fake résumés, videos and photos, and to navigate virtual job interviews, officials said. The fraudsters are also relying more on subcontractors in places like Pakistan and Nigeria to further obscure North Korean involvement, Mr. Leatherman said. 为逃避侦查，朝鲜IT工作者大军的战术在不断演变。官员们表示，这包括越来越多地依赖人工智能来伪造简历、视频和照片，以及应对虚拟求职面试。莱瑟曼说，欺诈者还日益依赖巴基斯坦和尼日利亚等地的分包商，以此进一步掩盖朝鲜的参与。 In an advisory released on Tuesday, the F.B.I. said the North Koreans were paying Americans and other Western accomplices to “perform a growing variety of identity and location obfuscation tasks” that included appearing on camera, participating in job interviews or meetings, verifying fraudulent identities, shipping packages, and even completing urinalysis tests or fingerprint submissions. 在周二发布的一份建议中，联邦调查局表示，朝鲜正在付钱给美国人和其他西方同谋，让他们“执行日益多样化的身份和位置混淆任务”，其中包括出境、参加求职面试或会议、验证虚假身份、寄送包裹，甚至完成尿检或指纹采集。 Dustin Volz为时报撰写网络安全和情报方面的文章，他常驻华盛顿。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
content: DUSTIN VOLZ 2026年10月14日 美国官员称，近年来，朝鲜通过远程IT工作者项目规避了国际制裁，赚取了数十亿美元的现金。 Anthony Wallace/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images The F.B.I. last month disrupted a widespread network of American facilitators accused of aiding the North Korean government in securing remote information technology jobs that helped fund the reclusive country’s nuclear and ballistic weapons programs, U.S. officials said Tuesday. 美国官员周二表示，联邦调查局上个月捣毁了一个由美国人组成的广泛网络，这些人被指控帮助朝鲜政府获取远程信息技术工作岗位，从而为这个与世隔绝的国家的核武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。 The operation included the dismantling of more than 40 so-called laptop farms across Texas and the seizure of nearly 200 computer devices, the officials said, marking one of the largest efforts to date by U.S. authorities to block a key revenue stream that has helped North Korea evade harsh international sanctions and generate billions in cash in recent years. 官员们表示，此次行动包括在得克萨斯州各地捣毁了40多个所谓“笔记本电脑农场”，并查获近200台计算机设备。这是美国当局迄今为止为阻断这一关键收入来源所采取的最大规模行动之一。近年来，这一收入来源帮助朝鲜规避了严厉的国际制裁，并创造了数十亿美元的现金。 The Justice Department separately unsealed indictments in Ohio on Tuesday against two U.S. nationals and 10 China-based North Koreans accused of committing identity theft to earn paychecks from unwitting American companies that hired them. Prosecutors said that scheme bilked 70 companies out of more than $3 million and ran from 2019 to 2025. The identities of two additional defendants remained under seal. 另外，美国司法部周二在俄亥俄州解封了针对两名美国公民和10名驻华朝鲜人的起诉书，指控他们通过盗用身份信息，从不知情的美国雇主处骗取薪资。检察官表示，该计划从2019年持续到2025年，骗取了70家公司超过300万美元。另外两名被告的身份仍处于保密状态。 The moves were the latest by the United States in an intensifying campaign to try to cut off a stealthy and evolving digital threat from North Korea whose scale is not entirely clear but likely vast. U.S. intelligence officials in both the Biden and second Trump administrations have said the I.T. worker scams are a primary method of funding Pyongyang’s weapons program, alongside thefts of cryptocurrency. 这些举措是美国在不断升级的行动中采取的最新手段，旨在试图切断来自朝鲜的隐秘且不断演变的数字威胁，这种威胁的规模尚不完全清楚，但可能非常庞大。拜登政府和第二届特朗普政府的美国情报官员都曾表示，IT人员诈骗与窃取加密货币一样，是为平壤武器项目提供资金的主要方式。 North Korea is deploying “thousands of state-controlled I.T. workers to infiltrate companies in the United States and allied countries,” Brett Leatherman, the head of the F.B.I.’s cyber division, said in an interview. “Every one of these jobs is funding a stream for a nuclear and ballistic missiles program obtained with the stolen identity of an American and the trust of an American employer.” “朝鲜正在部署数以千计受国家控制的IT人员，渗透美国及其盟国的企业，”联邦调查局网络部门负责人布雷特·莱瑟曼在接受采访时表示。“他们利用窃取的美国人身份和美国雇主的信任获得了这些工作，而每一份这样的工作都在为核武器和弹道导弹项目提供资金来源。” The bureau worked closely with the U.S.-based cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike to identify and disrupt the network, Mr. Leatherman said. He added that the coordinated actions were an early example of the F.B.I.’s new cyber strategy, which was unveiled last month and promised closer collaboration with the private sector to target hackers in ways that impede or thwart malicious activity. The strategy is part of a broader effort across the Trump administration to work more closely with American companies to strike hackers with cyberattacks, a pivot cautiously welcomed by some security experts. 莱瑟曼说，联邦调查局与总部位于美国的网络安全公司CrowdStrike密切合作，查明并捣毁了这个网络。他还说，这些协调行动是联邦调查局新网络战略的早期范例，该战略于上个月公布，承诺与私营部门加强合作，以阻碍或挫败恶意活动的方式打击黑客。该战略是 特朗普政府更广泛举措 的一部分，旨在与美国企业更紧密地合作，通过网络攻击打击黑客，一些安全专家对此转变表示谨慎欢迎。 U.S. officials and cybersecurity analysts have said the North Korean I.T. worker scheme is among the most serious ongoing digital threats facing businesses today, and that it remains underappreciated as a risk. Adam Meyers, who oversees counteradversary operations at CrowdStrike, said the North Korean schemes to get hired for jobs have been “increasing both in prevalence and complexity.” 美国官员和网络安全分析师表示，朝鲜IT人员骗局是当今企业面临的最严重的持续性数字威胁之一，但其风险仍被低估。负责CrowdStrike反制对手行动的亚当·迈耶斯表示，朝鲜获取雇佣的骗局“在普遍性和复杂性方面都在不断增加”。 It is difficult to know how widespread laptop farms are in the United States, Mr. Meyers said, but noted that CrowdStrike identified an average of two new cases per day throughout the month of September — which is likely only the tip of the iceberg. 迈耶斯说，目前尚难以确定笔记本电脑农场在美国的普及程度，但他指出，CrowdStrike在整个9月份平均每天发现两起新案例——而这可能只是冰山一角。 For more than two years, U.S. intelligence officials and cybersecurity researchers have warned that North Korea has been using stolen American identities — often acquired from compromised private information, like Social Security numbers, on the dark web — and artificial intelligence tools to get hired for remote information technology jobs at companies across the United States, Europe and elsewhere. Experts have said companies ranging from small start-ups to Fortune 500 firms have been victimized. 两年多来，美国情报官员和网络安全研究人员一直警告称，朝鲜一直在利用窃取的美国人身份——通常是从暗网上泄露的隐私信息中获取（如社会安全号码）——以及人工智能工具，在美国、欧洲及其他地方的公司获得远程信息技术工作。专家表示，从小微初创企业到财富500强公司，各类企业都已成为受害者。 A crucial aspect of the fraud campaign is support from people in the United States who are recruited by North Korea to help bypass corporate security measures that detect fraudulent hires, according to investigators. Facilitators help enable the fraud by receiving and setting up work laptops at addresses that appear like legitimate residences to corporate human-resources teams. North Korean operators then use software to remotely tunnel into those laptops and work on them, posing as Americans to the companies that hired them. 调查人员表示，这场欺诈活动的一个关键环节是来自美国境内人员的协助，他们被朝鲜招募，帮助绕过企业用于检测欺诈性雇佣的安全措施。协助者通过在看似合法住所的地址接收并设置工作笔记本电脑，从而为欺诈行为提供便利，使企业人力资源团队误以为这些地址是合法住所。然后，朝鲜操作员使用软件远程登录这些笔记本电脑并在其上工作，向雇佣他们的公司冒充美国人。 The appeal for facilitators is simple: jobs that look like easy cash and, at least at first, might not require much of them. “They get kind of hooked on it initially, and then more gets asked of them, and they’re kind of in too deep at that point,” Mr. Meyers said. 对协助者来说，诱惑很简单：这些工作看似能轻松赚钱，而且至少在最初可能不需要他们做太多事情。“他们一开始有点上瘾，然后被要求做得更多，到那个时候，他们就已经陷得太深了，”迈耶斯说。 Mr. Leatherman said that the Texas sweep did not include any arrests of facilitators, but that authorities warned them they could face criminal penalties should they continue to assist with remote fraud. The decision stemmed in part from a desire to move quickly to upend the network rather than wait for prosecutors to file charges, he said. 莱瑟曼说，得克萨斯州的扫荡行动中并没有逮捕任何协助者，但当局警告他们，如果继续协助远程欺诈，可能会面临刑事处罚。他说，这一决定部分源于希望迅速采取行动瓦解该网络，而不是等待检察官提起指控。 Mr. Leatherman said the laptop farms often operate like a “mini data center” for the North Koreans, where one facilitator hosts dozens or even hundreds of laptops used to fill scores of jobs. A woman in Arizona sentenced last year to more than eight years in prison was accused of hosting dozens of laptops at her home to help North Koreans connect to more than 300 U.S. companies. 莱瑟曼表示，这些笔记本电脑农场的运作模式往往就像一个朝鲜人的“迷你数据中心”， 一名协助者会托管数十台甚至数百台笔记本电脑，用于处理大量工作任务。去年一名女子在亚利桑那州被判处八年多监禁，她被控在其家中托管数十台笔记本电脑，帮助朝鲜人连接到300多家美国公司。 The tactics of North Korea’s I.T. worker army have steadily evolved to evade detection. That includes increased reliance on artificial intelligence to create fake résumés, videos and photos, and to navigate virtual job interviews, officials said. The fraudsters are also relying more on subcontractors in places like Pakistan and Nigeria to further obscure North Korean involvement, Mr. Leatherman said. 为逃避侦查，朝鲜IT工作者大军的战术在不断演变。官员们表示，这包括越来越多地依赖人工智能来伪造简历、视频和照片，以及应对虚拟求职面试。莱瑟曼说，欺诈者还日益依赖巴基斯坦和尼日利亚等地的分包商，以此进一步掩盖朝鲜的参与。 In an advisory released on Tuesday, the F.B.I. said the North Koreans were paying Americans and other Western accomplices to “perform a growing variety of identity and location obfuscation tasks” that included appearing on camera, participating in job interviews or meetings, verifying fraudulent identities, shipping packages, and even completing urinalysis tests or fingerprint submissions. 在周二发布的一份建议中，联邦调查局表示，朝鲜正在付钱给美国人和其他西方同谋，让他们“执行日益多样化的身份和位置混淆任务”，其中包括出境、参加求职面试或会议、验证虚假身份、寄送包裹，甚至完成尿检或指纹采集。 Dustin Volz 为时报撰写网络安全和情报方面的文章，他常驻华盛顿。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: 俄乌陷入经济战，特朗普助普京一臂之力
description: CONSTANT MÉHEUT2026年10月13日上个月，莫斯科一家炼油厂发生火灾，浓烟升腾。据当局称，此次火灾是由乌克兰无人机袭击引发的。 Reuters With the front lines largely frozen, Russia and Ukraine have turned the war into a contest of economic endurance. Kyiv has gone after Russia’s oil refineries. Moscow has hit Ukraine’s ports and heavy industries. 随着前线基本陷入僵局，俄罗斯和乌克兰已将战争变成一场经济耐力竞赛。基辅打击俄罗斯炼油厂。莫斯科则打击乌克兰港口和重工业。 On Friday, President Trump sided with Russia in this all-important battle. 上周五，特朗普总统在这场至关重要的较量中站在了俄罗斯一边。 The American leader announced a deal to buy Russian diesel fuel and stepped up pressure on Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries. The diesel agreement, if it goes ahead, could send some $4 billion of American money into the Russian economy, energy experts said. A halt to refinery strikes, if Ukraine accedes to one, could be much more valuable to the Kremlin. 这位美国领导人宣布了一项购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，并加大对乌克兰施压，要求其停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。能源专家称，如果该柴油协议推进，可能将有约40亿美元美国资金流入俄罗斯经济。如果乌克兰同意停止对炼油厂的袭击，这对克里姆林宫来说可能价值更大。 Mr. Trump is enlisting Russian help in his effort to bring down sky-high diesel prices, caused mostly by the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran, before the midterm election early next month. Ukraine is expected to get nothing in exchange, even as the American president demands an end to Kyiv’s refinery attacks, its most potent tool for depriving the Russian war machine of income. 特朗普正寻求俄罗斯帮助，以期在下月初中期选举前压低飞涨的柴油价格，柴油价格飙升主要是由美以对伊朗的战争造成的。美国总统要求基辅停止对炼油厂的袭击——这是乌克兰切段俄罗斯战争机器收入来源的最有力工具，但预计乌克兰得不到任何回报。 Moscow remains free to continue hitting Ukrainian ports, steel factories, warehouses, power plants and data centers, a campaign that is gradually pushing Ukraine’s economy toward a breaking point. Such attacks destroy nearly $10 billion in business assets each year, Ukraine’s economy minister has said. 莫斯科仍可继续打击乌克兰港口、钢铁厂、仓库、发电厂和数据中心，这一行动正逐渐将乌克兰经济推向崩溃边缘。乌克兰经济部长表示，此类袭击每年摧毁近100亿美元的商业资产。 周六，乌克兰扎波罗热，俄罗斯空袭后，救援人员抬着一名遇难者的遗体。 President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has condemned Mr. Trump’s decision to buy Russian diesel, saying in a social media post on Friday that “Russia will ‘repay’ the diesel with further terror and perfidy.” 乌克兰总统泽连斯基谴责特朗普购买俄罗斯柴油的决定，他上周五在社交媒体发帖称，“俄罗斯将用进一步的恐怖和背信弃义来‘回报’这些柴油。” Mr. Trump, who lifted sanctions to allow Russia to sell the fuel to the United States, struck an economic deal with Mr. Putin even as Russian attacks have driven civilian casualties in Ukraine to what the United Nations called a “new horrifying level.” 特朗普解除制裁，允许俄罗斯向美国出售该燃料，与普京达成经济协议，尽管俄罗斯的袭击已使乌克兰平民伤亡达到联合国所称的“新的骇人程度”。 More than 100 Ukrainian civilians were killed in the past week alone. Moscow is striking Ukraine with an ever growing arsenal of increasingly powerful and precise weapons, taking advantage of gaps in Ukrainian air defenses. 仅过去一周，就有100多名乌克兰平民丧生。莫斯科正利用乌克兰防空体系的漏洞，使用日益庞大、威力更强且精度更高的武器库对乌克兰发动袭击。 Mr. Zelensky said on Monday that Ukraine had refrained from attacks on Russian oil refineries overnight. But he has said that Ukraine will agree to an extended cease-fire only if Moscow stops attacking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. There are fears of a humanitarian crisis in Ukraine this winter if Russia succeeds in its goal of taking down the Ukrainian power and water systems. 泽连斯基周一表示，乌克兰在过去一晚未对俄罗斯炼油厂发动袭击。但他表示，只有莫斯科停止袭击乌克兰能源基础设施，乌克兰才会同意延长停火。人们担心，如果俄罗斯成功实现摧毁乌克兰电力和供水系统的目标，乌克兰今冬将出现人道主义危机。 The diesel deal is another sign of Mr. Trump’s willingness to tip the scales toward Russia, the aggressor in the conflict. This time, he is offering the Kremlin assistance in an economic battle that could help decide the fate of the war, with both armies largely bogged down at the front. 这笔柴油交易再次表明，特朗普愿意让天平向这场冲突中的侵略者俄罗斯倾斜。这一次，他在这场可能决定战争命运的经济战中向克里姆林宫提供援助，与此同时，俄乌两军在前线基本陷入僵局。 Ukraine’s campaign against Russian oil infrastructure began in 2024, with strikes on oil depots and refineries. The effort at first had little effect. But as Ukraine expanded its fleet of attack drones and learned how to target critical components that are hard to repair, the effects increased. 乌克兰对俄罗斯石油基础设施的行动始于2024年，当时袭击了油库和炼油厂。起初效果甚微。但随着乌克兰扩大攻击无人机机队规模，并掌握了如何锁定那些难以修复的关键部件，行动效果逐渐增强。 Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries, combined with those on other businesses, have cost Russia about 1 percent of its gross domestic product, President Vladimir V. Putin acknowledged this month. 普京总统本月承认，乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂及其他企业的袭击已使俄罗斯损失约1%的国内生产总值。 Reported gasoline output is down by 20 percent compared with 2025 levels, and diesel production is estimated to have fallen by nearly 30 percent, the International Energy Agency said in a report last month. The Ukrainian attacks prompted Russia to impose restrictions on diesel exports that Moscow now says it will lift to sell fuel to the United States. 国际能源署在上月一份报告中称，俄罗斯汽油产量较2025年水平下降了20%，柴油产量估计下降了近30%。乌克兰的袭击促使俄罗斯对柴油出口实施了限制，但莫斯科现在表示将解除这些限制，以便向美国出售燃料。 The energy agency added that Russia’s oil tax revenue from January to August was nearly 17 percent below the level of the same period in 2025. 国际能源署还称，俄罗斯1月至8月的石油税收入比2025年同期低近17%。 Should Kyiv be forced to halt its refinery strikes, Russia’s advantage in the two countries’ contest to starve the other of money will only grow. 如果基辅被迫停止对炼油厂的袭击，在两国通过经济手段相互施压的较量中，俄罗斯的优势只会扩大。 Nowhere is that imbalance clearer than in the near closure of Ukraine’s ports. 这种不平衡在乌克兰港口濒临关闭一事上表现得最为明显。 For months, Russia has attacked commercial ships sailing in and out of the ports in the southern region of Odesa, aiming to discourage them from calling there. The ports are a lifeline for Ukraine’s economy, accounting for 60 percent of the country’s total export volume. They are used to export grain from the country’s fertile farmland, a key source of revenue. 数月来，俄罗斯一直袭击进出敖德萨南部地区港口的商船，目的是阻止它们停靠那里。这些港口是乌克兰经济的生命线，占该国总出口量的60%。它们用于出口该国肥沃农田产出的谷物，这是乌克兰的重要收入来源。 5月，乌克兰敖德萨州的乔尔诺莫尔斯克港。俄罗斯的袭击严重限制了这座港口的出口。 Because of the Russian attacks, traffic through the three Odesa ports was down nearly 95 percent in August and September, compared with the same period last year, according to port data obtained by The New York Times. In September, only 12 ships made it out of the ports, compared to 266 in the same month last year. 根据《纽约时报》获得的港口数据，由于俄罗斯的袭击，8月和9月通过敖德萨三个港口的交通量较去年同期下降近95%。9月，只有12艘船驶出这些港口，而去年同期为266艘。 Ukraine has tried to redirect some of the traffic to its ports on the Danube River, which connects the country to Romania. Ships can travel down the river through Romania and back into the Black Sea, sailing off the coast of NATO countries toward Turkey. But the Danube ports can handle only about half of the cargo that normally moves through the Odesa ports. 乌克兰试图将部分交通转向其多瑙河港口，该河连接乌克兰与罗马尼亚。船只可以顺河而下，穿过罗马尼亚，再进入黑海，沿着北约国家海岸驶向土耳其。但多瑙河港口只能处理通常由敖德萨港口运输货物的大约一半。 And the Danube route is now under threat, too. Last week, drones struck three ships off the coasts of Romania and Bulgaria, sinking two and killing several crew members. All three vessels had carried Ukrainian grain in the past, according to Romanian authorities and port data. 多瑙河路线现在也受到威胁。上周，无人机袭击了罗马尼亚和保加利亚沿海的三艘船，击沉两艘，造成数名船员死亡。根据罗马尼亚当局和港口数据，这三艘船过去都曾运输乌克兰粮食。 Ukraine has accused Russia of carrying out the attacks, though Romania and Bulgaria have steered clear of assigning blame. Russia did not comment on the attacks. 乌克兰指责俄罗斯实施了这些袭击，但罗马尼亚和保加利亚均未明确归咎于任何一方。俄罗斯未对袭击置评。 The halt to Ukraine’s seaborne exports could have catastrophic consequences for the country’s economy, with effects across many sectors. Ukraine’s agriculture minister said this month that farmers were unable to export about 30 million tons of agricultural products, worth about $30 billion. 乌克兰海运出口的中断可能对该国经济造成灾难性后果，并影响许多行业。乌克兰农业部长本月表示，农民无法出口约3000万吨农产品，价值约300亿美元。 Russia has also suffered from Ukrainian strikes on its Black Sea ports, which have constrained its agricultural exports. But economists say the impact is not comparable because Russia has more export routes than Ukraine, including through the Baltic and Caspian Seas, which Ukrainian weapons cannot reach as easily. 俄罗斯也因乌克兰对其黑海港口的袭击而受损，其农产品出口受到限制。但经济学家表示，影响不可同日而语，因为俄罗斯比乌克兰拥有更多出口路线，包括通过波罗的海和里海，而乌克兰的武器难以轻易触及这些区域。 In a sign of that imbalance, Russia became the world’s largest exporter of sunflower oil in the 2025-26 marketing year, overtaking Ukraine for the first time in two decades, according to estimates from the U.S. Department of Agriculture. 这种不平衡的一个迹象是，根据美国农业部的估计，俄罗斯在2025-26销售年度成为世界最大葵花籽油出口国，20年来首次超过乌克兰。 Russia appears to be following a methodical approach to dismantling Ukraine’s economic base, striking all kinds of assets that an economy needs to function, including export routes, factories and energy facilities. 俄罗斯似乎正在有条不紊地瓦解乌克兰的经济基础，打击经济运转所需的各种资产，包括出口路线、工厂和能源设施。 The fate of Metinvest, Ukraine’s largest steel manufacturer, is a case in point. 乌克兰最大钢铁制造商梅廷维斯特的命运就是一个例证。 Its factories, including two large steel plants in southeastern Ukraine, were already suffering from power outages caused by Russian strikes on the grid. Then came attacks on the ports, which blocked a key export route, and on the railways, which left its products stranded inside the country. Finally, strikes on the plants themselves forced them to shut down last month. 该公司的工厂此前已因俄罗斯对电网的打击而遭受停电困扰，包括乌克兰东南部的两家大型钢厂。随后，港口遭到袭击，一条关键出口路线被阻断；铁路也遭到袭击，使其产品滞留在国内。最后，针对工厂本身的袭击迫使它们在上月关闭。 The collapse of Ukraine’s steel industry, which contributed more than 7 percent of Ukraine’s economic output last year, will have severe economic consequences, said Oleksandr Myronenko, Metinvest’s chief operating officer. The company is planning layoffs for administrative personnel, and towns that depend on steel plants will see their budgets shrink. 梅廷维斯特首席运营官亚历山大·米罗年科表示，乌克兰钢铁业的崩溃将带来严重经济后果；该行业去年贡献了乌克兰超过7%的经济产出。该公司正计划裁减行政人员，而那些依赖钢铁厂的城镇将面临财政预算缩减。 In September, for the first time in a century, not a single metric ton of steel was produced in Ukraine for one week. 9月，乌克兰出现了百年来首次一周内钢铁产量为零的情况。 Constant Méheut是时报记者，报道乌克兰战争。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。
content: CONSTANT MÉHEUT 2026年10月13日 上个月，莫斯科一家炼油厂发生火灾，浓烟升腾。据当局称，此次火灾是由乌克兰无人机袭击引发的。 Reuters With the front lines largely frozen, Russia and Ukraine have turned the war into a contest of economic endurance. Kyiv has gone after Russia’s oil refineries. Moscow has hit Ukraine’s ports and heavy industries. 随着前线基本陷入僵局，俄罗斯和乌克兰已将战争变成一场经济耐力竞赛。基辅打击俄罗斯炼油厂。莫斯科则打击乌克兰港口和重工业。 On Friday, President Trump sided with Russia in this all-important battle. 上周五，特朗普总统在这场至关重要的较量中站在了俄罗斯一边。 The American leader announced a deal to buy Russian diesel fuel and stepped up pressure on Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries. The diesel agreement, if it goes ahead, could send some $4 billion of American money into the Russian economy, energy experts said. A halt to refinery strikes, if Ukraine accedes to one, could be much more valuable to the Kremlin. 这位美国领导人宣布了一项购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，并加大对乌克兰施压，要求其停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。能源专家称，如果该柴油协议推进，可能将有约40亿美元美国资金流入俄罗斯经济。如果乌克兰同意停止对炼油厂的袭击，这对克里姆林宫来说可能价值更大。 Mr. Trump is enlisting Russian help in his effort to bring down sky-high diesel prices, caused mostly by the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran, before the midterm election early next month. Ukraine is expected to get nothing in exchange, even as the American president demands an end to Kyiv’s refinery attacks, its most potent tool for depriving the Russian war machine of income. 特朗普正寻求俄罗斯帮助，以期在下月初中期选举前压低飞涨的柴油价格，柴油价格飙升主要是由美以对伊朗的战争造成的。美国总统要求基辅停止对炼油厂的袭击——这是乌克兰切段俄罗斯战争机器收入来源的最有力工具，但预计乌克兰得不到任何回报。 Moscow remains free to continue hitting Ukrainian ports, steel factories, warehouses, power plants and data centers, a campaign that is gradually pushing Ukraine’s economy toward a breaking point . Such attacks destroy nearly $10 billion in business assets each year, Ukraine’s economy minister has said . 莫斯科仍可继续打击乌克兰港口、钢铁厂、仓库、发电厂和数据中心，这一行动正 逐渐将乌克兰经济推向崩溃边缘 。乌克兰经济部长 表示 ，此类袭击每年摧毁近100亿美元的商业资产。 周六，乌克兰扎波罗热，俄罗斯空袭后，救援人员抬着一名遇难者的遗体。 President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine has condemned Mr. Trump’s decision to buy Russian diesel, saying in a social media post on Friday that “Russia will ‘repay’ the diesel with further terror and perfidy.” 乌克兰总统泽连斯基谴责特朗普购买俄罗斯柴油的决定，他上周五在社交媒体 发帖 称，“俄罗斯将用进一步的恐怖和背信弃义来‘回报’这些柴油。” Mr. Trump, who lifted sanctions to allow Russia to sell the fuel to the United States, struck an economic deal with Mr. Putin even as Russian attacks have driven civilian casualties in Ukraine to what the United Nations called a “new horrifying level.” 特朗普解除制裁，允许俄罗斯向美国出售该燃料，与普京达成经济协议，尽管俄罗斯的袭击已使乌克兰平民伤亡达到联合国 所称 的“新的骇人程度”。 More than 100 Ukrainian civilians were killed in the past week alone. Moscow is striking Ukraine with an ever growing arsenal of increasingly powerful and precise weapons, taking advantage of gaps in Ukrainian air defenses. 仅过去一周，就有100多名乌克兰平民丧生。莫斯科正利用乌克兰防空体系的漏洞，使用日益庞大、威力更强且精度更高的武器库对乌克兰发动袭击。 Mr. Zelensky said on Monday that Ukraine had refrained from attacks on Russian oil refineries overnight. But he has said that Ukraine will agree to an extended cease-fire only if Moscow stops attacking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. There are fears of a humanitarian crisis in Ukraine this winter if Russia succeeds in its goal of taking down the Ukrainian power and water systems . 泽连斯基周一表示，乌克兰在过去一晚未对俄罗斯炼油厂发动袭击。但他表示，只有莫斯科停止袭击乌克兰能源基础设施，乌克兰才会同意延长停火。人们担心，如果俄罗斯成功实现 摧毁乌克兰电力和供水系统的目标 ，乌克兰今冬将出现人道主义危机。 The diesel deal is another sign of Mr. Trump’s willingness to tip the scales toward Russia, the aggressor in the conflict. This time, he is offering the Kremlin assistance in an economic battle that could help decide the fate of the war, with both armies largely bogged down at the front. 这笔柴油交易再次表明，特朗普愿意让天平向这场冲突中的侵略者俄罗斯倾斜。这一次，他在这场可能决定战争命运的经济战中向克里姆林宫提供援助，与此同时，俄乌两军在前线基本陷入僵局。 Ukraine’s campaign against Russian oil infrastructure began in 2024 , with strikes on oil depots and refineries. The effort at first had little effect. But as Ukraine expanded its fleet of attack drones and learned how to target critical components that are hard to repair, the effects increased. 乌克兰对俄罗斯石油基础设施的行动 始于2024年 ，当时袭击了油库和炼油厂。起初效果甚微。但随着乌克兰扩大攻击无人机机队规模，并掌握了如何锁定那些难以修复的关键部件，行动效果逐渐增强。 Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries, combined with those on other businesses, have cost Russia about 1 percent of its gross domestic product, President Vladimir V. Putin acknowledged this month. 普京总统本月承认，乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂及其他企业的袭击已使俄罗斯损失约1%的国内生产总值。 Reported gasoline output is down by 20 percent compared with 2025 levels, and diesel production is estimated to have fallen by nearly 30 percent, the International Energy Agency said in a report last month. The Ukrainian attacks prompted Russia to impose restrictions on diesel exports that Moscow now says it will lift to sell fuel to the United States. 国际能源署在上月一份 报告 中称，俄罗斯汽油产量较2025年水平下降了20%，柴油产量估计下降了近30%。乌克兰的袭击促使俄罗斯对柴油出口实施了限制，但莫斯科现在表示将解除这些限制，以便向美国出售燃料。 The energy agency added that Russia’s oil tax revenue from January to August was nearly 17 percent below the level of the same period in 2025. 国际能源署还称，俄罗斯1月至8月的石油税收入比2025年同期低近17%。 Should Kyiv be forced to halt its refinery strikes, Russia’s advantage in the two countries’ contest to starve the other of money will only grow. 如果基辅被迫停止对炼油厂的袭击，在两国通过经济手段相互施压的较量中，俄罗斯的优势只会扩大。 Nowhere is that imbalance clearer than in the near closure of Ukraine’s ports. 这种不平衡在乌克兰港口濒临关闭一事上表现得最为明显。 For months, Russia has attacked commercial ships sailing in and out of the ports in the southern region of Odesa, aiming to discourage them from calling there. The ports are a lifeline for Ukraine’s economy, accounting for 60 percent of the country’s total export volume. They are used to export grain from the country’s fertile farmland, a key source of revenue. 数月来，俄罗斯一直 袭击进出敖德萨南部地区港口的商船 ，目的是阻止它们停靠那里。这些港口是乌克兰经济的生命线，占该国总出口量的60%。它们用于出口该国肥沃农田产出的谷物，这是乌克兰的重要收入来源。 5月，乌克兰敖德萨州的乔尔诺莫尔斯克港。俄罗斯的袭击严重限制了这座港口的出口。 Because of the Russian attacks, traffic through the three Odesa ports was down nearly 95 percent in August and September, compared with the same period last year, according to port data obtained by The New York Times. In September, only 12 ships made it out of the ports, compared to 266 in the same month last year. 根据《纽约时报》获得的港口数据，由于俄罗斯的袭击，8月和9月通过敖德萨三个港口的交通量较去年同期下降近95%。9月，只有12艘船驶出这些港口，而去年同期为266艘。 Ukraine has tried to redirect some of the traffic to its ports on the Danube River, which connects the country to Romania. Ships can travel down the river through Romania and back into the Black Sea, sailing off the coast of NATO countries toward Turkey. But the Danube ports can handle only about half of the cargo that normally moves through the Odesa ports. 乌克兰试图将部分交通转向其多瑙河港口，该河连接乌克兰与罗马尼亚。船只可以顺河而下，穿过罗马尼亚，再进入黑海，沿着北约国家海岸驶向土耳其。但多瑙河港口只能处理通常由敖德萨港口运输货物的大约一半。 And the Danube route is now under threat, too. Last week, drones struck three ships off the coasts of Romania and Bulgaria , sinking two and killing several crew members. All three vessels had carried Ukrainian grain in the past, according to Romanian authorities and port data. 多瑙河路线现在也受到威胁。上周， 无人机袭击了罗马尼亚和保加利亚沿海的三艘船 ，击沉两艘，造成数名船员死亡。根据罗马尼亚当局和港口数据，这三艘船过去都曾运输乌克兰粮食。 Ukraine has accused Russia of carrying out the attacks, though Romania and Bulgaria have steered clear of assigning blame. Russia did not comment on the attacks. 乌克兰指责俄罗斯实施了这些袭击，但罗马尼亚和保加利亚均未明确归咎于任何一方。俄罗斯未对袭击置评。 The halt to Ukraine’s seaborne exports could have catastrophic consequences for the country’s economy, with effects across many sectors. Ukraine’s agriculture minister said this month that farmers were unable to export about 30 million tons of agricultural products, worth about $30 billion. 乌克兰海运出口的中断可能对该国经济造成灾难性后果，并影响许多行业。乌克兰农业部长本月表示，农民无法出口约3000万吨农产品，价值约300亿美元。 Russia has also suffered from Ukrainian strikes on its Black Sea ports , which have constrained its agricultural exports. But economists say the impact is not comparable because Russia has more export routes than Ukraine, including through the Baltic and Caspian Seas, which Ukrainian weapons cannot reach as easily. 俄罗斯也因 乌克兰对其黑海港口的袭击 而受损，其农产品出口受到限制。但经济学家表示，影响不可同日而语，因为俄罗斯比乌克兰拥有更多出口路线，包括通过波罗的海和里海，而乌克兰的武器难以轻易触及这些区域。 In a sign of that imbalance, Russia became the world’s largest exporter of sunflower oil in the 2025-26 marketing year, overtaking Ukraine for the first time in two decades, according to estimates from the U.S. Department of Agriculture . 这种不平衡的一个迹象是， 根据美国农业部的估计 ，俄罗斯在2025-26销售年度成为世界最大葵花籽油出口国，20年来首次超过乌克兰。 Russia appears to be following a methodical approach to dismantling Ukraine’s economic base, striking all kinds of assets that an economy needs to function, including export routes, factories and energy facilities. 俄罗斯似乎正在有条不紊地瓦解乌克兰的经济基础，打击经济运转所需的各种资产，包括出口路线、工厂和能源设施。 The fate of Metinvest, Ukraine’s largest steel manufacturer, is a case in point. 乌克兰最大钢铁制造商梅廷维斯特的命运就是一个例证。 Its factories, including two large steel plants in southeastern Ukraine , were already suffering from power outages caused by Russian strikes on the grid. Then came attacks on the ports, which blocked a key export route, and on the railways, which left its products stranded inside the country. Finally, strikes on the plants themselves forced them to shut down last month. 该公司的工厂此前已因俄罗斯对电网的打击而遭受停电困扰，包括 乌克兰东南部的两家大型钢厂 。随后，港口遭到袭击，一条关键出口路线被阻断；铁路也遭到袭击，使其产品滞留在国内。最后，针对工厂本身的袭击迫使它们在上月关闭。 The collapse of Ukraine’s steel industry, which contributed more than 7 percent of Ukraine’s economic output last year, will have severe economic consequences, said Oleksandr Myronenko, Metinvest’s chief operating officer. The company is planning layoffs for administrative personnel, and towns that depend on steel plants will see their budgets shrink. 梅廷维斯特首席运营官亚历山大·米罗年科表示，乌克兰钢铁业的崩溃将带来严重经济后果；该行业去年贡献了乌克兰超过7%的经济产出。该公司正计划裁减行政人员，而那些依赖钢铁厂的城镇将面临财政预算缩减。 In September, for the first time in a century, not a single metric ton of steel was produced in Ukraine for one week. 9月，乌克兰出现了百年来首次一周内钢铁产量为零的情况。 Constant Méheut 是时报记者，报道乌克兰战争。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 为何大学校园强奸案反复重演？
description: KATRIN BENNHOLD2026年10月13日康奈尔大学Chi Phi兄弟会所。 Lauren Petracca for The New York Times Last weekend, over brunch, my 14-year-old daughter brought up the alleged rape at Cornell, one of America’s top universities. I was surprised. She had a lot to say; it was all over her social media feeds, she told me. 上周末吃早午餐时，我14岁的女儿提到了美国顶尖学府康奈尔大学发生的那宗涉嫌强奸案。我颇感意外。她对此滔滔不绝，告诉我自己的社交媒体已被这起事件刷屏。 The lawsuit filed by a former student over what happened to her two years ago has reignited a national conversation in the United States about sexual assault on college campuses. It has also sparked conversations in my daughter’s high school in Wales, in my wider German family, in a WhatsApp group I share with friends from around the world. 一名前学生就两年前的遭遇提起的诉讼在全美重新引发了关于大学校园性侵的大讨论。这场讨论同样波及我女儿就读的威尔士高中、我在德国的大家族亲属，以及我与全球友人共享的WhatsApp群组。 Today I write about why the Cornell story is both a very American story — and one of the most universal stories of all. 今天，我撰文探讨康奈尔事件为何既极具美国色彩又是全人类最具普遍性的事件之一。 Why Cornell is resonating everywhere 康奈尔事件为何在各处引发共鸣 One young woman, naked and alone. A group of young men taking turns performing sexual acts on her. Dehumanizing messages exchanged on a Snapchat group including more than 50 men. 一名年轻女性，赤身裸体，孤立无援。一群年轻男子轮流对她实施性侵犯。一个超过50名男性组成的Snapchat群组里充斥着各种非人化的言论。 What took place on the night of Oct. 19, 2024, at Cornell University is now subject to a lawsuit filed by the young woman. There’s still a lot we don’t know: The seven defendants claim the sex was either consensual, initiated by the woman herself, or that they didn’t participate. The woman says it was assault. 2024年10月19日夜间发生在康奈尔大学的事如今已成为这位年轻女子的诉讼依据。我们仍有诸多细节无从知晓：七名被告要么声称涉案性行为属双方自愿并由该女性主动发起，要么坚称自己并未参与。这名女子则表示这是一场性侵。 But there’s a lot we do know. We know she made a report to the university police a few weeks later, telling them she could say “with 100 percent confidence I was raped.” We also know that the document the university police shared with prosecutors did not include that part of her statement, and that prosecutors in turn declined to pursue the case. 但也有很多是我们确知的。我们知道，她在数周后向校警报案，并表示自己可以“百分之百肯定遭到了强奸”。我们同样知道，校警向检方提交的卷宗里并未包含其陈述的这一部分，检方随后也决定不对该案提起公诉。 Some of the above — the competing narratives, the sense of institutional failure — might feel familiar to readers around the world. But the setting where it took place likely will not. 上述某些情节——各执一词的说法、体制给人留下的全面失能的印象——世界各地的读者或许都不陌生。然而，此事的背景可能并不会让人觉得熟悉。 Because at the heart of this story is a particularly American institution: the fraternity. 因为处于这场风波核心的，是一个极具美国特色的制度组织：兄弟会(fraternity)。 America’s fraternity culture 美国的兄弟会文化 Fraternities — residential social clubs named, somewhat quirkily, after Greek letters — are almost as old as America itself. Chi Phi, the fraternity at the center of the Cornell case, is widely regarded as the nation’s oldest, having been founded in 1824. 兄弟会——这些有着略显怪异的希腊字母名称的住宿型社交俱乐部——历史几乎与美国本身一样悠久。处于康奈尔案中心的Chi Phi被公认为全美历史最悠久的兄弟会，创立于1824年。 Since then, fraternities — along with sororities, their female counterparts — have become a fixture on campuses across the U.S., giving students a sense of belonging and a lifelong professional network. 自那时起，兄弟会以及对应的女性组织姐妹会(sorority)便成为全美大学校园不可或缺的常态，为学生提供归属感和终身职业人脉网络。 They’re also regularly under investigation for a range of offenses, including substance abuse, dangerous initiation rituals and, yes, sexual assault. My colleagues compiled a bunch of recent examples, including two fraternity houses at Penn State that prosecutors say were central to a cocaine distribution ring; a fraternity ritual at Northern Arizona University that left a student dead; and a lawsuit filed by a former student of the University of South Florida who said she was given alcohol until “helpless,” and then sexually assaulted at a fraternity event. 这些组织也频繁因一系列违法违规行为接受调查，包括物质滥用、危险的入会仪式，当然还有性侵。我的同事梳理了一批近期的案例，其中包括：检方指控作为可卡因交易据点的宾夕法尼亚州立大学两处兄弟会会所；北亚利桑那大学导致一名学生死亡的入会仪式；以及南佛罗里达大学一名前学生提起的诉讼，指控自己在兄弟会活动中被灌酒至“无力反抗”后遭到性侵。 The Cornell case has only increased the scrutiny. 康奈尔大学的案件更是让此类审视持续升温。 My colleague Emma Goldberg, who has been reporting from the Cornell campus, told me that a few ingredients can come together at fraternities to create a fertile environment for harmful behavior. (Watch her video above.) 一直在康奈尔大学现场报道的同事埃玛·戈德堡告诉我，多种因素在兄弟会交织叠加，为有害行为滋生提供了温床。（观看她的视频。） Fraternities are often all-male. They’re selective — those who want to join typically have to go through initiation rituals. They’re usually residential — fraternity members live in a shared house. And their parties tend to be the center of campus social life. 兄弟会通常全由男性组成。它们有严苛的选拔机制——申请加入者通常须经历入会仪式。它们通常兼具住宿属性——成员共同生活在同一栋房屋内。它们的派对往往是校园社交生活的核心。 This tight-knit, single-sex environment fuels a strong sense of brotherhood, Emma said. “You’ve been in the trenches together and you’re bonded and you kind of feel that you owe one another everything,” she told me. Women, in this world, tend to be secondary. 埃玛指出，这种紧密且单一性别的环境助长了强烈的兄弟情谊。“你们共同经历过摸爬滚打，关系紧密相连，在某种程度上甚至觉得彼此休戚与共，”她告诉我。而在这样的圈子里，女性往往沦为次要角色。 The parties, in turn, provide a sense of social power. Combine all this and you get a dynamic in which some members can feel emboldened to misbehave, and others an obligation to stand by their brothers regardless of what they do. At Cornell, Emma told me, students joining a fraternity sometimes sign a pledge to protect its secrets. 与此同时，派对反过来赋予了成员一种社交权力感。将所有这些因素交织在一起，就会形成一种行为机制：部分成员因盲目膨胀而肆无忌惮地做出不端行为，其他成员则认为无论兄弟做了什么都有义务予以支持庇护。埃玛告诉我，在康奈尔大学，加入兄弟会的学生有时还会签署保守组织秘密的誓约。 Supporters of fraternities point to research that suggests they help improve universities’ student retention and graduation rates. 兄弟会的支持者则援引相关研究指出，兄弟会有助于提高大学的学生留校率和毕业率。 But opponents point to reports like one Cornell issued in March. It showed 52 percent of Cornell undergraduate women affiliated with Greek life organizations (as fraternities and sororities are often called) reported experiencing sexual assault. Among other undergraduates with no such affiliation, it was 29 percent. 但反对者列举了诸如康奈尔大学今年3月发布的一份报告。报告显示，隶属于希腊生活组织（对兄弟会与姐妹会等社团的称呼）的康奈尔大学本科女性中，有52%表示曾遭遇过性侵；而在没有此类社团归属的其他本科女性中，这一比例为29%。 上周在康奈尔大学的抗议。 Heather Ainsworth for The New York Times A familiar story 似曾相识的事件 Fraternities may be uniquely American; sexual assault is not. If the Cornell incident has resonated around the world, it’s because the same ingredients that make some fraternities toxic exist elsewhere, too. 兄弟会社团或许为美国所独有，性侵现象却并非如此。康奈尔事件之所以在世界各地引起共鸣，是因为导致部分兄弟会走向畸变毒化的相同诱因在其他地方同样存在。 I spoke to Michael Flood, an Australian professor of sociology who studies the social dynamics of male-dominated groups. He told me in such environments — whether it’s an American fraternity, an Australian football team, a British military unit or an Indian Instagram group chat — men can sometimes care more about the approval of other men than about the humanity of women. Add high levels of alcohol, drug and/or pornography use, and “you get a greater risk of sexual violence by members of that subculture.” 我采访了专门研究男性主导群体社会机制的澳大利亚社会学教授迈克尔·弗拉德。他向我表示，在类似的环境中——不论是美国的大学兄弟会、一支澳大利亚橄榄球队、一个英国军队单位，还是一个印度Instagram聊天群——男性有时更看重同性群体的认可，而非女性的人格尊严。一旦叠加酗酒、药物滥用或沉溺色情内容，“该亚文化圈成员实施性暴力的风险就会显著攀升。” “There’s nothing specifically American about this,” Flood said. All countries have “contexts where male bonding, norms of male loyalty, codes of sexism and objectification are strong”: Women are of interest primarily as sexual partners, and men get status through sexual conquest or the mistreatment of women. Some Cornell fraternities had openly sexist rituals like inviting a group of sorority members to serve the brothers dinner while being plied with alcohol, Emma told me. “这绝非美国独有的现象，”弗拉德表示。所有国家都存在“男性抱团纽带、男性忠诚规范、性别歧视与物化女性准则根深蒂固的环境”：在这些环境中，女性主要被当作性伴侣看待，男性则通过性征服或虐待女性来获取群体地位。埃玛告诉我，康奈尔大学的部分兄弟会甚至存在公开的性别歧视仪式，例如邀请一群姐妹会成员在被劝酒的同时为兄弟会成员侍奉晚餐。 Chi Phi was banned from campus after the former student first reported being raped in 2024. The woman is now suing the university, Chi Phi, her own sorority and the seven men she says attacked her. 在这名前学生于2024年首次报案遭强奸后，Chi Phi便被禁止在校园内开展活动。这名女性目前正对康奈尔大学、Chi Phi、她自己所在的姐妹会以及指控对其施暴的七名男子提起诉讼。 None of the men have been charged with a crime. Prosecutors have said they’ll reopen the investigation, and Cornell plans to hire an outside team to investigate the case. 目前涉案男子均未受到刑事指控。检方已表示将重启调查，康奈尔大学也计划聘请外部团队调查此案。 No matter the verdict, the defendants aren’t the only ones facing judgment. title: 全球首富的崛起之路：马斯克纪录片讲了些什么
description: MATTHEW HUFF2026年10月13日纪录片里的马斯克。 Bleeker Street Alex Gibney opens his documentary about the tech titan Elon Musk with a question: “How could Musk assume so much power, and why had we given it to him?” 亚历克斯·吉布尼关于科技巨头埃隆·马斯克的纪录片以这样一个问题开场：“马斯克怎么能获得这么大的权力，而我们又为什么把这些权力交给了他？” The Oscar-winning filmmaker, whose previous subjects include Enron and Scientology, spends nearly four hours answering that question in “Musk,” tracing the rise of the Tesla chairman and chief executive from his childhood in South Africa to the I.P.O. of SpaceX in June, which made Musk the world’s first trillionaire. (The movie, in theaters, has a 10-minute intermission baked in.) 这位曾经拍过安然公司和山达基教的奥斯卡获奖导演在《马斯克》一片中用近四个小时的时间来回答这个问题，追溯了这位特斯拉董事长兼首席执行官的崛起之路，从他在南非的童年一直讲到今年6月SpaceX首次公开募股——这让马斯克成为世界上首位身家达到万亿美元的富豪。（这部正在影院上映的电影安排了10分钟的中场休息。） When news of Gibney’s project broke back in 2023, Musk took to Twitter (now X) to preemptively call it a “hit piece.” Combining interviews with ex-wives and former colleagues and clips from Musk’s 30-plus years in the spotlight with commentary from an A.I. version of Musk constructed from an archive of his own words, the film follows his rise from Silicon Valley start-ups to his brief tenure as the de facto head of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE). 2023年，吉布尼正在拍摄这部纪录片的消息传出后，马斯克就在Twitter（现称X）上先发制人，称其为“抹黑之作”。影片采访了马斯克的前妻和前同事，穿插他过去30多年间在公众视野中留下的影像资料，还利用他过去的语音档案建立了一个人工智能版马斯克，让这个虚拟人物对影片内容发表评论。影片记录了马斯克从硅谷创业到短暂担任政府效率部实际负责人的崛起历程。 Here are some takeaways. 以下是影片的几个要点。 影片追溯了这位特斯拉董事长兼首席执行官从南非童年到SpaceX于6月IPO的崛起之路。 Musk’s privileged childhood was marred by violence 马斯克家境优渥的童年笼罩着暴力阴影 “Musk” paints a harrowing portrait of Elon’s youth in apartheid-era South Africa. In one interview, his wealthy businessman father, Errol Musk, claims to have shot and killed three intruders, covering the floor of their home in a “swimming pool” of blood. In another, he describes Elon riding in a car alongside the body of a family friend who had just “dropped dead.” After Elon’s mother, Maye Musk, separated from Errol, claiming physical and mental abuse (charges her former husband has denied), Elon continued to live with his father. When Elon was bullied so badly at school that he was hospitalized for a week, his father, he later said, sided with his attackers. 《马斯克》描绘了埃隆在当时实行种族隔离制度的南非度过的童年岁月，揭示了一段令人不寒而栗的往事。在一次采访中，他的父亲、富商埃罗尔·马斯克声称自己曾开枪打死三名闯入者，鲜血流了一地，在家中地板上积成了一个“游泳池”。在另一次采访中，他描述埃隆坐在一辆车里，旁边是一位刚“猝死”的家族朋友的尸体。埃隆的母亲梅耶·马斯克与埃罗尔分居时，指控丈夫对她实施身体和精神虐待（她的前夫否认了这些指控），但埃隆仍然选择和父亲一起生活。有一次，埃隆在学校遭到严重霸凌，以至于住院一周。据他后来回忆，父亲当时却站在欺负他的那些人一边。 He’s made a habit of failing upward 他屡屡因失败而获利 Gibney suggests that Elon Musk’s business blunders have been as lucrative as his successes. After a failed bid to become the chief executive of his first start-up, Zip2, Musk was pushed out of the company but earned a $22 million buyout. Only a few years later, the entrepreneur and venture capitalist Peter Thiel pushed Musk out of PayPal with a $250 million parting gift. 吉布尼认为，埃隆·马斯克在商业上的失误给他带来的财富并不亚于成功为他带来的财富。他曾试图成为自己创办的第一家初创企业Zip2的首席执行官，但未能如愿，随后被赶出公司，却拿到了2200万美元的收购所得。仅仅几年后，企业家兼风险投资人彼得·蒂尔又将马斯克赶出了贝宝，而马斯克离开时获得了2.5亿美元。 More recently, according to Gibney, Twitter (now X) lost 80 percent of its value after Musk purchased it (though other estimates vary). Musk then rolled X and his A.I. start-up xAI into SpaceX for the largest I.P.O. on record to date, prompting Gibney to ask, “How can you keep screwing up and still make millions?” 吉布尼称，更近的例子是，Twitter（现X）在马斯克收购后损失了80%的价值（不过，不同机构的估算并不一致）。马斯克随后将X和他的AI初创公司xAI并入SpaceX，完成了有记录以来最大的IPO，这让吉布尼不禁发问：“你怎么能一次又一次把事情搞砸，却依然赚得盆满钵满？” Tesla is a lesson in entrepreneurial sleight of hand 特斯拉背后的商业障眼法 While Musk claims to be a founder of Tesla, the automotive company was actually started by Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning in 2003. However, Musk negotiated the title of co-founder for himself as part of a 2009 legal settlement. Later, he claimed that Tesla drivers could easily swap out their 1,000-pound car batteries, which helped him garner more than $100 million worth of environmental credits from the state of California, though he had only built a single battery swap facility in the desert. 虽然马斯克自称是特斯拉的创始人，但这家汽车公司实际上由马丁·艾伯哈德和马克·塔彭宁于2003年创立。不过，在2009年达成的一项法律和解协议中，马斯克通过谈判为自己争取到了联合创始人的头衔。后来，他又宣称，特斯拉车主可以轻松更换重达450公斤的汽车电池，这帮助他从加利福尼亚州获得了价值超过1亿美元的环保积分，尽管他仅在沙漠里建了一个电池更换站。 Gibney also dedicates substantial time to Tesla’s self-driving Autopilot feature, which has been linked to deaths and injuries. In 2016, Musk oversaw the creation of a promotional video depicting a self-driving Tesla, causing the company’s stock to rise. However, it was later revealed that humans had controlled the car at certain points during filming and that the car had actually crashed. 吉布尼还用了相当长的篇幅讨论特斯拉的自动驾驶Autopilot系统，该系统被指与多起造成人员伤亡的事故有关。2016年，马斯克主导制作了一段展示特斯拉汽车自动驾驶的宣传视频，推动了公司股价上涨。然而，后来有消息披露，拍摄过程中，汽车在某些时刻实际上由人控制，而且那辆车还发生了撞车事故。 按照吉布尼在片中的说法，马斯克通过星链巩固了自己的政治权力。星链是SpaceX的卫星部门，从太空提供互联网接入。 He sees increasing the birthrate as a “national emergency” 他把提高出生率视为“国家紧急事务” “Musk” includes extended interviews with Justine Musk, Elon’s first wife, and Ashley St. Clair, a former conservative influencer who dated Elon from 2023 to 2025 and gave birth to one of his 14 known children. St. Clair claims to have received messages from multiple women on social media whom Musk offered to impregnate. “It’s like a Gatling gun of sperm in his DMs,” she says in one of the documentary’s more evocative lines. 《马斯克》对埃隆的第一任妻子贾斯廷·马斯克以及曾经的保守派网红阿什莉·圣克莱尔进行了长时间采访。圣克莱尔在2023年至2025年间与埃隆交往，并为他生下一个孩子（马斯克为公众所知的孩子共有14个）。圣克莱尔称，她在社交媒体上收到多名女性发来的私信，她们都说马斯克曾提出要让她们怀孕。她在纪录片中用了一句格外生动的比喻：“他在私信里到处播种，简直就像一挺喷射精子的加特林机枪。” Despite Musk’s preoccupation with procreating, both women suggest that Musk sustains little interest in his children or their mothers. Justine remembers Elon telling her, “I am the alpha in this relationship” at their wedding reception, and later telling her, “If you were my employee, I’d fire you.” St. Clair claims Musk openly called X Æ A-Xii (whose mother is Musk’s former partner Claire Boucher, the musician known as Grimes) his favorite and didn’t care to spend time with his other offspring. 尽管马斯克对生育如此执着，但这两名女性都表示，他对自己的孩子及孩子的母亲几乎没有持续的关心。贾斯廷回忆说，埃隆曾在两人的婚宴上对她说：“在这段关系里，我是老大。”后来又对她说：“如果你是我的员工，我早就把你开除了。”圣克莱尔则称，马斯克曾公开表示，X Æ A-Xii（其母是马斯克之前的伴侣、音乐人格莱姆斯，本名克莱尔·布歇）是他最喜欢的孩子，她还说他不怎么愿意花时间陪伴其他子女。 Starlink and DOGE gave him global reach 星链和政府效率部让他的影响力遍及全球 According to Gibney, Musk has been able to consolidate political power via Starlink, the satellite arm of SpaceX, which provides internet access from space. While Musk supplied Ukrainian forces with necessary tech during their war with Russia, he’s also able to control and withhold access to it. That military bargaining chip has given Musk remarkable leverage in lucrative business deals around the world. 据吉布尼说，马斯克得以通过星链巩固政治权力。星链是SpaceX的卫星部门，从太空提供互联网接入。虽然马斯克在俄乌战争中向乌克兰军队提供了必要的技术，但他同样能够控制甚至切断对这项技术的使用。这一军事筹码让马斯克在全球利润丰厚的商业交易中拥有了非同寻常的议价能力。 As part of his work with DOGE, Musk dispatched gatekeepers and regulations designed to check the A.I. industry. With those barriers removed, Gibney speculates that Musk could use A.I. to amass even more power. 在政府效率部任职期间，马斯克清除了旨在约束人工智能行业的监管把关机制和规定。吉布尼推测，随着这些障碍被移除，马斯克可能利用人工智能进一步扩大自己的权力。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
